title: Helpful but not perfect
text: Helpful but not perfect. I was excited to use this.  I figured 10 feet would be enough to fill any pie shell and keep it in place.  However, the 10 foot chain barely coves the bottom of the pie and does nothing for the sides (which like to slide, sadly, and that's almost as important to me as not bubbling on the bottom). I'll keep these, and use them, but I"ll likely just go back to using uncooked beans--better weight, easier to distribute.
